changelog: 🚀 Single Unified JIN APK (jin-termux-v2.1.3): Fully merged JIN and Mobile-Harness into a single complete production release, dropping cumbersome multi-flavor splits.
🎛️ 3-Way Mode Switcher: Toggle effortlessly between JIN Classic, JIN+Harness Fusion, and Harness Studio from the header banner.
🛠️ 100 Tools UI & Card Density Modes: Completely fixed badge letter-wrapping bugs; added Compact, Comfortable, and 2-Column Grid density toggles for maximum mobile usability.
🤖 Harness Studio: Autonomous coding turns powered by DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode Zen, Claude Code, and Antigravity CLI with live reasoning accordion.
📁 On-Device Android App Scaffolder: 1-Tap Jetpack Compose and XML project generation attributed to Samir Ahmmed.
🔍 Real-Time Workspace Changes Diff: Line-by-line colored diffs with per-file 'Undo Change' and 'Keep Change' buttons powered by WorkspaceCheckpoints.
🔨 Gradle On-Device Build & Rootless Installer: Compile debug APKs on-device and install instantly using Android PackageInstaller Session API.
